title: Technical Debt & Refactoring Strategy
objectives: Classify debt as deliberate/prudent vs reckless/inadvertent
Refactor incrementally under feature pressure using seams

examples.name: parallel-change.ts

exercise.prompt: Match each signal to its meaning: "same files in every PR", "backwards imports", "features need workarounds", "tests skipped for demo (ticket filed)".
hints: Erosion shows up as friction before it shows up as bugs.
A filed ticket makes debt deliberate and prudent.

questions.prompt: The safe order of parallel change is…
questions.explanation: Add the new shape, migrate callers incrementally, then remove the old — always shippable.

questions.prompt: Refactoring without tests is dangerous because…
options: you cannot verify behavior is preserved
questions.explanation: Tests are the behavior-preservation oracle; without them a refactor is a rewrite gamble.
